recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Any future change to allow child question answers without a parent answer should be a new SDC/FHIR-I decision because it would reverse FHIR-32665's explicit cardinality rule.
issue_request: FHIR-32665 asked whether a QuestionnaireResponse child question can have an answer under item.answer.item when the parent item.answer has no value. The final Published/Persuasive resolution was to make QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.value[x] 1..1 and omit item.answer when there is no answer.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to HL7/fhir#1337. Commit 35ff6ea60f17c3279bb14071bfb3a9b73a89aa34 changed source/questionnaireresponse/structuredefinition-QuestionnaireResponse.xml from min 0 to min 1 for QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.value[x], and merge commit 0a821bba35de3393a12e90941568eaa9cd01471b merged PR #1337 with the message Fix FHIR-32665/26292.
additional_context: QuestionnaireResponse is active in source/fhir.ini. The originating Zulip discussion explains that child questions under a question are per-answer details and are meaningless without a parent answer; a later Zulip thread cites FHIR-32665 when confirming that children without an answer are invalid. FHIR SDC minutes from 2021-07-22 record approval of FHIR-32665 as Persuasive. A separate existing FHIR-6906 combined-branch audit covers older questionnaire answer-nesting history and treats FHIR-32665 as later supporting context.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because source/questionnaireresponse/structuredefinition-QuestionnaireResponse.xml already has QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.value[x] at min 1/max 1 and leaves QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.item nested under a particular answer.

related_jiras.note: Existing no-change audit on the combined branch covers older questionnaire answer-nesting history and cites FHIR-32665 as a later supporting decision.
